limitations: Not a complete catalog, official rank, representative sample or independently measured heat score.
Plays and likes have no observed accumulation period; do not assume 24-hour or lifetime totals.

Browser compatibility warning remained but discovery metadata was readable.
Only general discovery cards collected; no account identity, history, profile links, email, secrets, personal recommendations or credentials stored.
Same games may occur in both batches; deduplicate by identity_key only for entity counts, not section observations.
Detail-page counts are separate observations of the same metric and must not be added to discovery-card counts.

Four of the first five unique detail pages supplied metadata; the fifth remained unavailable after cloud-browser protocol timeouts. Browser-compatibility game-loading warnings were observed on three captured detail pages. No play button was clicked.
All 13 current visible cover URLs were attempted through supported media download and timed out. No prior image was substituted; repository paths and hashes remain null.
